zh: 本机 Magpie 网关新增图片和视频模型支持：接入时自动同步 Magpie 的对话、生图与生视频模型列表，可直接在生图和后台视频任务中使用，并绕过系统代理直连本机网关。
修复 Windows 桌面灵动岛点击后无法可靠切回并聚焦主窗口的问题，改善点击灵动岛跳转收件箱与多实例激活体验。
新增 Keenable 可选网页搜索服务商，可在设置中填写 API Key 后启用。
en: Local Magpie gateway now supports image and video models: configuring Magpie automatically syncs its chat, image, and video catalogs for image generation and approved background video jobs, connecting directly to localhost without routing through a proxy.
Fixes Windows desktop Live Island activation so clicking the island reliably brings the main window to the foreground and jumps to the inbox.
Adds Keenable as an optional keyed web search provider in Settings.
